data.jobAdText:
Kontron is a global leader in IoT/Embedded Computing Technology (ECT). Kontron offers individual solutions in the areas of Internet of Things (IoT) and Industry 4.0 through a combined portfolio of hardware, software and services. With its standard and customized products based on highly reliable state-of-the-art technologies, Kontron provides secure and connected applications for a wide variety of industries. As a result, customers benefit from accelerated time-to-market, lower total cost of ownership, extended product lifecycles and fully integrated applications. 


The Technical Product Manager supports the Product & Portfolio Management team by helping coordinate product development activities, translate market and customer requirements into actionable product inputs, and support execution across North America. This role serves as a technical and product-facing bridge between Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, Operations, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders. 


The position supports development and maintenance of Product Standards groups aligned by vertical market, including transportation, medical, industrial, defense, and aerospace. These Product Standards groups are intended to improve consistency across product lines, support platform reuse, define common product expectations, identify capability gaps, and provide a structured forum for aligning customer needs, market requirements, compliance considerations, and product development priorities. 


This role is intended to carry strong technical and product-development expectations while remaining cross-functional and product-facing. The position does not initially carry people-management responsibility; instead, it provides specialized product development coordination, requirements interpretation, standards organization, and execution support for portfolio activities, product readiness, and lifecycle planning.  


     

Essential   Duties & Responsibilities: ­ 

·  Support   Product Managers in developing, documenting, and executing product plans,   product requirements, roadmap inputs, and lifecycle activities across   assigned product lines. 

· Assist in identifying market needs, customer   requirements, product capability gaps, technical risks, and opportunities for   improved portfolio positioning. 

· Translate customer, market, and technical   requirements into clear, actionable product inputs for Product Management,   Engineering, Sales, Business Development, Operations, and Marketing. 

· Develop, maintain, and improve Product Standards   groups aligned by vertical market, including transportation, medical,   industrial, defense, and aerospace. 

· Coordinate Product Standards group activities,   meeting inputs, action items, documentation, and follow-up actions to support   consistent product expectations and decision-making across verticals. 

· Define and maintain vertical-specific product   standards, product architecture expectations, compliance considerations,   capability matrices, gap lists, assumptions, and next-step actions. 

· Support the use of standard product architectures,   reusable platforms, modular design approaches, and consistent requirements   across product lines where applicable. 

· Support tracking, coordination, and review of   product development schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and   risks for assigned initiatives.     

· Coordinate with R&D, Product Management,   Operations, Marketing, Sales, Business Development, and Supply Chain to   maintain alignment between product plans, customer needs, and development   deliverables. 

· Support customer, partner, and internal   stakeholder discussions by providing technically accurate product input,   standards context, and development status information. 

· Track relevant industry trends, certification   requirements, regulatory considerations, customer expectations, and   competitive activity impacting assigned vertical markets. 

· Support product readiness reviews including   documentation, validation alignment, launch preparation, sales enablement,   product messaging, and internal stakeholder readiness. 

· Support RFP, RFQ, proposal, and customer response   activities by providing product development input, capability alignment,   standards information, and technical positioning support. 

· Support development of sales and marketing   collateral by validating product messaging, claims, technical content, and   vertical-specific positioning. 

· Monitor customer feedback, product performance   input, and market response to recommend product improvements, roadmap   adjustments, or new development opportunities. 

· Support product lifecycle management activities   including new product introduction, sustaining improvements, obsolescence   planning, feature enhancements, and end-of-life coordination. 

· Build and maintain working relationships with   internal stakeholders, product teams, engineering resources, sales teams, and   external partners to improve product alignment and execution. 

· Provide regular status updates to leadership   regarding product development progress, open risks, standards group activity,   resource needs, schedule concerns, and recommended actions. 

· Drive continuous improvement in product   development processes, documentation quality, requirements tracking,   standards organization, and cross-functional communication practices.  

 

Qualifications: 

· Bachelor’s   degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering,   Product Management, Business, or related technical field preferred. 

· 5–10 years of experience in product development,   product management, systems engineering, embedded systems, hardware   platforms, rugged computing, or related technical product environments. 

· Experience working with embedded computing   systems, hardware platforms, boards, modules, systems, or complex technical   products preferred. 

· Ability to read and interpret customer   requirements, product specifications, technical standards, compliance   expectations, and market requirements and convert them into practical product   inputs and action plans. 

· Experience supporting product lifecycle, roadmap   planning, product standards, product requirements, RFP/RFQ responses,   customer discussions, launch readiness, or project coordination preferred. 

· Familiarity with vertical market requirements for   transportation, medical, industrial, defense, and aerospace applications   preferred. 

· Strong communication skills with the ability to   explain technical and product concepts clearly to Product Management,   Engineering, Sales, customers, and external stakeholders. 

· Effective cross-functional collaboration skills;   able to influence and coordinate without direct authority. 

· Strong organizational skills with attention to   details, schedules, matrices, documentation, standards tracking, and   follow-up actions. 

· Ability to balance strategic product thinking with   hands-on execution, tactical problem solving, and disciplined follow-through.   

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools required;   experience with project management, PLM, CRM, ERP, or requirements management   tools preferred. 

· Travel domestically as needed for customer   meetings, partner discussions, industry events, internal alignment meetings,   and product development reviews.

In addition to being an established global presence with opportunities for growth, Kontron encourages communication through all levels of the organization to ensure a common direction and allow our employees to make informed decisions. Our culture has been created by the people who work here, making Kontron a fast-paced, friendly, and enjoyable workplace with competitive salaries, excellent benefits, and a flexible-shift 9/80 work (eligibility determined by department) which gives employees every other Friday off. Kontron America, Inc. 

Position Summary

The Repair Technician 3 – Systems plays a critical role in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing returned Kontron products, including rackmount servers, industrial PCs, and computing peripherals. Operating with limited supervision, this technician ensures repairs and rework are executed with precision and aligned to company quality standards, ISO procedures, and department-level OKRs. This role supports a best-in-class customer experience by enabling fast, accurate system turnaround and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across Technical Services. As a senior-level technician, this position also functions as a technical mentor and problem-solving leader within the team.


Key Responsibilities

System-Level Repair & Diagnostics

  • Perform advanced diagnostics and repairs on rackmount servers, medical systems, industrial PCs, and peripheral components.
  • Accurately execute system-level upgrades and modifications using Product Work Instructions (PWI) and schematics.
  • Follow Special Repair Instructions (SRI) and manage daily priorities through the scheduling tool (Velosity).
  • Ensure repairs meet the standard 15-business-day turnaround metric.

Process & Quality Adherence

  • Adhere to ISO-compliant procedures and department SOPs; support organizational and department-level OKRs.
  • Maintain documentation accuracy in the ERP system for repair tracking, inventory control, and quality metrics.
  • Prepare detailed failure analysis reports and repair estimates for out-of-warranty units.

Collaboration & Technical Support

  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Support teams to resolve escalated or novel technical challenges.
  • Provide feedback on design and reparability to improve future products and reduce repeat RMAs.
  • Communicate directly with customers to clarify technical issues and ensure resolution quality.

Mentorship & Technical Leadership

  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) and provide peer coaching on diagnostic methods and internal procedures.
  • Model best practices in troubleshooting, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, innovation, and high performance.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Associate’s Degree in Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent technical/military training.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on system-level repair experience involving servers, industrial PCs, or modules.
  • Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma or continuous improvement principles is a strong plus.

Technical Skills

  • Proficient in assembly, diagnostics, and repair of rackmount servers and industrial computers.
  • Knowledge of remote server management tools and out-of-band system maintenance.
  • Working experience with Windows Server, general Windows OS, and Linux distributions.
  • ERP system proficiency for service tracking and workflow updates (SAP preferred).
  • Competency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook).

Soft Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and multitasking capabilities.
  • Positive, flexible attitude in dynamic environments.
  • Collaborative team player with strong work ethic and integrity.

Additional Requirements

  • Must participate in Kontron’s FAA Drug & Alcohol Abatement Program (unless management exempts).
  • Occasional travel may be required depending on project or site-specific needs.

Kontron is looking for an honorable, professional, ethical, team player to work in a team environment who wants to be a contributor to the success of the organization. Feel up to the challenge? If this is you click Apply now!

We combine rugged hardware, modular software, and long-term lifecycle services so OEMs and system integrators can accelerate time-to-market, lower total cost of ownership, and keep platforms supported and secure for years.


In addition to being an established global presence with opportunities for growth, Kontron encourages communication through all levels of the organization to ensure a common direction and allow our employees to make informed decisions. Our culture has been created by the people who work here, making Kontron a fast-paced, friendly, and enjoyable workplace with competitive salaries and excellent benefits.


We have an exciting opportunity for a Strategic Partner Sales Manager. The Strategic Partner Sales Manager is responsible for developing and managing strategic partnerships that drive revenue growth for embedded computing platforms, industrial gateways, edge AI systems, IoT software, and related solutions. This role will recruit, enable, and manage channel partners, system integrators, distributors, OEMs, and technology alliance partners throughout North America. The successful candidate will develop joint business plans, identify new market opportunities, drive pipeline growth, and increase revenue through partner-led and partner-influenced sales.

  

Key Responsibilities:

Partner Development

  • Recruit and onboard new strategic channel partners, OEMs, VARs, distributors, and      system integrators.
  • Manage existing partners and develop plan to grow existing partner, agent network
  • Build executive-level relationships with partner leadership teams.
  • Develop annual business plans and revenue targets with key partners.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews and strategic planning sessions.
  • Create partner growth plans and measurable performance objectives.

Revenue Growth

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue opportunities.
  • Identify new market opportunities in: 
    • Industrial IoT
    • Embedded Computing
    • Transportation
    • Medical
    • Defense & Aerospace
    • Telecom & 5G
    • Smart City Applications
  • Develop go-to-market strategies with channel partners.
  • Support partners throughout the sales cycle from prospecting through award.

Technical Solution Selling

  • Position and promote: 
    • Embedded Computers
    • Single Board Computers (SBC)
    • System-on-Modules (SOM)
    • Industrial PCs
    • Edge AI Platforms
    • IoT Gateways
    • Windows IoT Solutions
    • Kontron  OS based Solutions
    • 5G  Connectivity Products
    • Cloud-connected IoT Platforms
  • Coordinate technical resources to support customer requirements and demonstrations.

Partner Enablement

  • Conduct partner training programs.
  • Develop sales tools, presentations, and competitive positioning materials.
  • Coordinate joint marketing campaigns and trade show activities.
  • Educate partners on new product launches and solution updates.

Opportunity Management

  • Maintain accurate forecasts and pipeline reporting within CRM.
  • Track partner performance metrics and revenue attainment.
  • Coordinate with product management, engineering, operations, and marketing teams.
  • Provide executive management with regular business updates and revenue forecasts.

Sales Management

  • Manage inside sales rep(s) work load, provide direction and outline key business indicators for successful partner growth.

  

Required Qualifications:


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, or related field.
  • MBA preferred but not required.

Experience

  • 7+ years of channel sales, partner management, or strategic account management experience.
  • 5+ years selling technology solutions involving: 
    • Embedded Computing
    • Industrial Automation
    • IoT Solutions
    • Networking
    • Edge Computing
    • Telecommunications
  • Proven history of meeting or exceeding annual sales targets.
  • Experience working with OEMs, system integrators, distributors, and value-added resellers.
  • Experience developing and executing partner business plans.

  

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates should have experience in one or more of the following sectors:

  • Embedded Computing
  • Industrial Automation
  • IoT Platforms
  • Edge AI
  • Medical Devices
  • Transportation Systems
  • Telecommunications
  • Defense & Aerospace
  • Industrial Networking
  • Smart Manufacturing

  

Technical Knowledge

Preferred experience with:

  • Windows IoT
  • Linux Operating Systems
  • Industrial Networking
  • Cloud IoT Platforms
  • Edge AI Architectures
  • Intel and ARM Platforms
  • Wireless and Cellular Technologies
  • Private 5G Networks
  • Device Management Platforms

  

Core Skills


Sales Skills

  • Strategic Account Planning
  • Channel Development
  • Consultative Selling
  • Opportunity Qualification
  • Executive Presentations
  • Contract Negotiation
  • Revenue Forecasting
  • Territory Development

Business Skills

  • Business Plan Development
  • Financial Analysis
  • Partner Performance Management
  • Market Analysis
  • Competitive Positioning
  • Pipeline Management

Leadership Skills

  • Relationship Building
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Influencing Without Authority
  • Executive Communication
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Problem Solving

  

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to be used

  • Annual Revenue Achievement
  • Partner-Sourced Revenue
  • Partner-Influenced Revenue
  • New Partner Acquisition
  • Pipeline Growth
  • Number of Joint Customer Engagements
  • Quarterly Business Review Completion
  • Opportunity Conversion Rate
  • New Customer Wins
  • Forecast Accuracy

  

Travel Requirements

  • Ability to travel 40-60% throughout North America.
  • Attendance at partner meetings, customer engagements, industry events, and trade      shows.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Hunter mentality with strong relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable engaging VP, GM, and C-level executives.
  • Strong understanding of embedded computing, gateways, IoT software, and edge solutions.
  • Proven ability to build channel ecosystems that generate measurable revenue growth.
  • Able to bridge technical and business discussions to create value for customers and partner

We have an exciting remote opportunity for a professional role as a Field Applications Engineer- Broadband 2 within our hardware sector to join our Kontron Family! 



About Us


We are a leading provider of broadband access equipment, delivering innovative solutions that enable service providers to expand network capacity, improve efficiency, and enhance customer experience. Our portfolio includes fiber (PON/FTTx) OLTs, ONTs, and wireless CPEs designed to meet the demands of large, regional, and rural service providers.


Position Overview


We are seeking a Field Applications Engineer (FAE) to join our customer-facing engineering team. The FAE will work closely with

sales, product management, and R&D teams to provide technical expertise, ensure successful customer evaluations, and support

deployments of our broadband access equipment. This role requires a strong technical background in access technologies, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with customers in both pre-sales and post-sales engagements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide pre-sales technical support to service providers, including product presentations, solution design, and technical proposals.
  • Lead proof-of-concept (PoC) trials, lab evaluations, and field demonstrations of broadband access equipment.
  • Assist customers with network design, integration, and interoperability testing with OSS/BSS, management platforms, and third-party systems.
  • Act as a technical liaison between customers and internal teams (R&D, product management, and support).
  • Deliver technical training and knowledge transfer to customers, partners, and internal teams.
  • Provide post-sales support during deployment, including troubleshooting, configuration, and performance optimization.
  • Capture customer feedback and contribute to product roadmap discussions.


 Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of experience as an FAE, sales engineer, systems engineer, or network engineer in broadband access, telecom, or networking industry.
  • Strong understanding of PON (XGS-PON, GPON), Wi-Fi, VoIP, Ethernet switching, and IP networking.
  • Familiarity with OLTs, ONTs, Wi-Fi CPEs, and broadband network design.
  • Experience with network management protocols (SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, TR-069, TR-369) and OSS/BSS integration.
  • Hands-on experience with lab testing, interoperability trials, and customer demos.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with packet captures, lab tools, and diagnostic platforms.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Willingness to travel (50%) to customer sites, labs, and industry events.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge broadband technologies.
  • High-visibility role with direct impact on sales success.
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Career development and training opportunities.
